p: city of David: That was in Zion 2Sa 5:7,9.
ark of the LORD unto his: From the house of Obed Edom, 2Sa 6:10,12.
Elizaphan: Who was the son of Uzziel, the fourth son of Kohath, Ex 6:18,22, Nu 3:30.
Hebron: The third son of Kohath, Ex 6:18.
sanctify yourselves: Prepare yourselves and be pure, abstain from all things by which you might be polluted, and so not able to come to the tabernacle.
order: According as he has appointed in the law.
instruments of musick: These instruments and other ceremonies which they observed, were instructions of their infancy, which continued to the coming of Christ.
second degree: Which were inferior in dignity.
Alamoth: This was an instrument of music or a certain tune, to which they sang psalms.
Sheminith to excel: Which was the eighth tune, over which he that was most excellent had charge.
was for song: That is, to appoint Psalms and songs to them that sang.
for the ark: With Berechiah and Elkanah, 1Ch 15:23.
helped the Levites that bare the: That is, gave them strength to execute their office.
seven bullocks and seven rams: Besides the bullock and the fat beast which David offered at every sixth pace, 2Sa 6:13.
covenant of the LORD came to: It was so called because it reminded the Israelites of the Lord's covenant made with them.
